extraction.Name: Antoine Randall, senior
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his 320 acre allotment at the time it was issued, but he was advised by the Indian Agency that it would be assessed with taxes, and sold for them, if he did not accept the patent, so he took it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his allotment, in 1920, for about $3000.00, part in cash and part in trade, stock, chickens, etc
extraction.Buyer: Bud Thomas, of Wanblee, South Dakota
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: was advised by the Indian Agency that it would be assessed with taxes, and sold for them, if he did not accept the patent
extraction.Occupation/Income: only income is what lease money he gets from leasing one quarter of land, while he lives on the other
extraction.NOTES: mentally incompetent; getting feeble and is nearly blind; wife died in 1926; has two children and three grandchildren to support; children have good health; has never got any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; sold 320-acre allotment, retains one quarter on which he lives; document sworn December 10, 1928 | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
